rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the process of making wild animals or plants domestic, especially in technical or written contexts.

example.english: This study explores the history of plant domestication.
example.traditional: 呢項研究探討野生植物馴化嘅歷史。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 jin4 gau3 taam3 tou2 je5 saang1 zik6 mat6 seon4 faa3 ge3 lik6 si2

rows.note: Use this for the taming and raising of animals, rather than the broader process that can also include plants.

example.english: After domestication, this dog has become very obedient.
example.traditional: 呢隻狼狗經過馴養之後，已經好聽話喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 zek3 long4 gau2 ging1 gwo3 seon4 joeng5 zi1 hau6 ji5 ging1 hou2 teng1 waa6 laa3
